review_evidence: The README describes formalizations of finite-state Markov chains, Gibbs and Metropolis-Hastings MCMC, Perron-Frobenius theory, spectral material, and countable-kernel groundwork.
A scan of the 36 Lean files found 577 theorem/lemma/example/axiom declaration lines.

Representative results include isStochastic_iff_isMarkovKernel, kernel_isIrreducible_of_isIrreducible, stochasticAugmentation_isStochastic, and truncation_perronRoot_monotone_convergence; the unit therefore carries substantial unique formal mathematics.
summary: Retain the MCMC/Perron-Frobenius development: the unit consists of theorem-bearing probability, Markov-chain, and spectral formalization.
